attribution: New AI-assisted follow-up reproduction; not the original Forage submission or historical performance.

data.units: price units from the supplied CSV

method: Joint least-squares intercept, linear time trend, annual sine and cosine; fixed before evaluation. No tuning on test values.

holdout.horizon: One fixed 12-month forecast; the model is not refitted inside the test period.

rolling.horizon: Expanding-window one-month forecasts, refit using only earlier observations.

limitations: One small historical educational series; this is not evidence of live-market forecasting performance.
Original price records remain private; the public demo uses separately generated synthetic inputs.
No prediction interval or trading return is estimated.

verification.independentCheck: Eight MAE/RMSE values independently recomputed with NumPy least squares; absolute difference below 1e-9.
